papers.paper: EgoForesight: Effectively Scaling Policy Learning with Noisy Egocentric Actions
papers.figure: Full architecture from the paper, linked from the official project's method section
papers.tldr: Scales robot policy learning with noisy egocentric actions by accounting for label reliability and distilling action-relevant knowledge from demonstrated future outcomes.

papers.paper: CLAP: Contrastive Latent Action Pretraining for Learning Vision-Language-Action Models from Human Videos
papers.figure: CLAP method overview from the official project page
papers.tldr: Transfers manipulation skills from human videos to robots by contrastively aligning visual transitions with an executable latent action vocabulary.

papers.paper: VLA-RL: Towards Masterful and General Robotic Manipulation with Scalable Reinforcement Learning
papers.figure: Figure 2: The overall pipeline of VLA-RL
papers.tldr: Improves pretrained vision-language-action models through scalable online reinforcement learning, using a robotic process reward model to guide exploration.

papers.paper: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
papers.tldr: Unifies world prediction and action generation in one causal model, showing that learning to predict action outcomes and learning to act improve each other.

papers.paper: Coevolutionary Continuous Discrete Diffusion: Make Your Diffusion Language Model a Latent Reasoner
papers.figure: Figure 3: Framework of Coevolutionary Continuous Discrete Diffusion
papers.tldr: Jointly denoises continuous representations and discrete tokens to combine expressive latent reasoning with effective language-model training and generation.

papers.paper: Thinking With Videos: Multimodal Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Long Video Reasoning
papers.figure: Overview of the VITAL framework from the official project page's Architecture section
papers.tldr: Teaches video models to retrieve relevant frames while reasoning, using tool-augmented reinforcement learning for long-video question answering and temporal grounding.

papers.paper: OccNeRF: Advancing 3D Occupancy Prediction in LiDAR-Free Environments
papers.figure: Method pipeline from the official project page
papers.tldr: Learns semantic 3D occupancy from multi-camera images without LiDAR or 3D supervision, combining neural rendering, photometric consistency, and 2D semantic cues.

papers.paper: SkillMemo: Expert-guided Skill Memory Framework for Compositional Embodied Manipulation
papers.figure: Figure 2: Overview of the SkillMemo framework
papers.tldr: Improves compositional manipulation by decomposing demonstrations into reusable latent skills and retrieving relevant skill memories to guide action prediction.

papers.paper: SAFE-Pruner: Semantic Attention-Guided Future-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.figure: Figure 4: The overall framework of SAFE-Pruner
papers.tldr: Accelerates vision-language-action inference by forecasting deep-layer token importance, preserving task-critical visual information while pruning redundant tokens.

papers.paper: StableVLA: Towards Robust Vision-Language-Action Models without Extra Data
papers.figure: Architecture of IB-Adapter and StableVLA from the official project page
papers.tldr: Improves robustness to unseen visual disturbances with a lightweight information bottleneck adapter that filters visual noise without extra data or augmentation.

papers.paper: DSPv2: Improved Dense Policy for Effective and Generalizable Whole-body Mobile Manipulation
papers.figure: DSPv2 method pipeline from the official project page
papers.tldr: Combines multi-view semantic features with 3D spatial perception and a dense action head to improve generalization and generate coherent whole-body manipulation.

papers.paper: GeoLRM: Geometry-Aware Large Reconstruction Model for High-Quality 3D Gaussian Generation
papers.figure: Method pipeline from the official GeoLRM project page
papers.tldr: Reconstructs detailed 3D Gaussian assets from multiple images using sparse 3D anchor points and geometry-aware attention, enabling efficient reconstruction with dense input views.

papers.paper: Semantic Ray: Learning a Generalizable Semantic Field with Cross-Reprojection Attention
papers.figure: Semantic Ray method pipeline from the official project page
papers.tldr: Learns generalizable semantic fields by aggregating context across reprojected image rays, using efficient attention to transfer semantic understanding to previously unseen scenes.
